greet: Bịaruo nso, nwa m. Nke a bụ ite ụrọ anyị. Anyị na-akpọ ya ikoko.
greet.ask: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ ite ahụ?
made: Ọkpụite ji aka kpụọ ya site n'ụrọ osimiri, mesịa sie ya ike n'ọkụ ghere oghe.
made.ask: Kedu ka e si eme ite ahụ?
old: Ụmụ nwanyị nọ n’ala ndị a akpụtala ite dị otu a kemgbe ọtụtụ puku afọ. A na-ahụ iberibe ite ndị ahụ n’ebe obodo ndị kacha ochie dịbu.
old.ask: Afọ ole ka ite ụrọ dị?
potters: A na-esi n’aka nne enyefe nka a n’aka nwa ya nwanyị. Onye ọkpụ ite ọ bụla nwere akara nke ya, ya mere ị pụrụ ịmata aka onye kpụrụ ite ahụ.
mother: Nke a bụ nke nne m. O ji ya buru mmiri si n’osimiri n’isi ya, ma nye m ya n’ụbọchị agbamakwụkwọ m.
water: Anyị na-edebe mmiri ọṅụṅụ anyị n’ime ya. Ụrọ ahụ na-eku ume, ya mere mmiri ahụ na-adị jụụ, ọbụna n’etiti ehihie.
water.ask: Gịnị mere mmiri ji anọgide na-ajụ oyi?
cook: Ite ọzọ dị ka nke a na-anọkwasị n'elu nkume atọ n'elu ọkụ, ofe anyị ana-esikwa n'ime ya.
cook.ask: Gịnị ka ị na-esi n’ime ya?
care: Welie ya nwayọọ ma jiri aka abụọ jide ya. Ite ụrọ dara ada anaghị ebili ọzọ.
